verdict.rationale: Metronome documents a revenue-recognition capability in its financial-reporting guides. It stores the raw data needed to manage complex revenue recognition for usage-based models, at daily granularity by product and revenue category. However, the evidence never shows it producing ASC 606 / IFRS 15 recognition, deferred revenue schedules, or audit-ready reports itself, and the warehouse export suggests users build those reports elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit ASC 606/IFRS 15 recognition logic, deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data

citations.quote: Metronome stores all of the raw data necessary to manage complex revenue recognition for usage-based business models... with daily granularity down to products and revenue categories.
